item.title: What about VSAN for SMB/SME?
item.description: Unless you have been sleeping under a rock you will be aware that VSAN was launched last week and has gone GA today and from what I have seen so far I do think VSAN is a great product and I think VMware have done a superb job with it.

item.title: Online Archiving with Exchange 2010? Can’t see your Online Archive in Outlook?
item.description: Having recently managed several Exchange 2010 migration projects, one of the best new features which really sells it to systems administrators is the Online Archive. “No more managing PST files? When can we have it installed by?”
